title: Ayushman Bharat Haryana Health Protection Mission Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Haryana government implementation of government-funded health assurance for eligible families, integrated with PM-JAY and state-specific beneficiary categories.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows PM-JAY/state beneficiary lists and Haryana's notified categories and rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat Haryana Health Protection Mission.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
